QA Summary - Issue #63

Issue Add Street Builder Page
Task Link #63
Environment Strapi API http://192.168.1.200:1337, production site https://gothru.co, external target https://streetbuilder.co/, BE source gothru-marketing-strapi, FE source gothru-marketing-next-js
Test Date 2026-07-24

Executive Summary

Issue #63 is passed. The requested Street Builder navigation target is available from the real CMS-backed global menu/footer data as Street Builder with link https://streetbuilder.co/ and newTab: true.

Production homepage payload also includes the Street Builder navigation entry in both Header and Footer data, while the homepage product showcase CTA points directly to https://streetbuilder.co/. The external destination itself returns 200 OK and serves the StreetBuilder page.

No tested endpoint returned HTTP 500.

White Box Check FE header/footer handling FE can render CMS external links in new tab Header/Footer transform Link submenu type and external/new-tab links correctly Passed
